subject: Super Donkey Kong 99 remaining endgame protection across original, f1 and Russian translation
scope: Static exact-byte comparison plus forced-PC real native M68K execution of unchanged producer and endgame consumer. Bounded 1200-frame normal boot runs are separate evidence and do not prove an organic playthrough or all endgame content. No user ROM modifications.

remaining_consumer.mismatch_effect: sets FF00E6=10 at 14F0, then 1578/1580 loops forever while it equals 10

literal_false_positives.meaning: Unaligned occurrence crossing preceding instruction bytes into BRA.W at 1968, 779C and B3E0; not evidence of an absolute protection access.

matching: exact producer, port-table and ending-check functional signatures
CRC32 of logical bytes 0200..10000 equals 2419C93C (byte-order independent, excludes header)
implementation.hardware: Routes hardware_header=0000 / hardware_checksum=16DC to the existing original SDK99 rom_database entry; no f1/translation entries, ROM edits or bypasses.
implementation.load_cost: At most 65024 CRC bytes after short signature checks; no per-frame fingerprint work.
implementation.checksum_guard: Same family recognition is consulted by md_cart_preserve_header_checksum.
implementation.state: Existing cart.hw register payload and native state layout reused without extension.
implementation.recording_compatibility: Only recognized family content whose original header/real key differs from 0000:16DC gets sdk99-hardware-v1 recording/network tag. Original and unrelated games keep their previous tags. Flag initialized per load and cleared on unload; advisory mismatch behavior retained in frontend.

conclusion: Original already had the required hardware. f1 and Russian translation retained the same late protection producer and consumer but previously missed hardware identification; family code recognition now reuses original hardware and passes the actual native endcheck. Full playthrough remains outside this evidence.
